payload.title: File:Dinosaur size.png
payload.credit_html: Slate Weasel's silhouettes, Anaxibia's bird size comparison (File:Pelagornis sandersi compare size.png), and Matt Martyniuk's Shantungosaurus (File:Largestdinosaursbysuborder scale.png) and Triceratops (File:Eotriceratops scale.png).
payload.description_html:
Aprox. length of the creatures in this image:
  • Puertasaurus (Green): 30 m
  • Futalognkosaurus (Dark Blue): 26 m
  • Shantungosaurus (Olive): 15 m
  • Stegosaurus (Pink): 7,5 m
  • Triceratops (Light Blue): 8 m
  • Supersaurus (Dark Grey): 35 m
  • Apatosaurus (Reddish Orange): 26 m
  • Spinosaurus (Yellow): 14 m
  • Homo sapiens (Black): 1,8 m
